head: 7 new travel apps for iPhone climbing the App Store this week
dek: Seven travel apps released in the last 60 days rose into the US App Store's Travel charts this week, from Watchmen's camera map to an offline voice translator.
where: iPhone and iPad, US App Store Travel charts this week
means: If you're planning a trip, an RV weekend or a cruise, a few of these do one travel job for a one-time price.
todo: Check the App Store page for the price and in-app purchases first: My City Days charges for each trip plan.

list.name: Watchmen: what's watching you?
list.what: Maps public surveillance cameras such as license plate readers and traffic cameras, from OpenStreetMap data.

list.name: Chocka: RV Leveling Checklist
list.what: Tells you which RV or trailer wheel goes on the leveling blocks and how high, using your phone's tilt sensor.

list.name: TidyMap - Neighborhood Guide
list.what: Lets you collect the city neighborhoods you've visited, with a short local guide for each one.

list.name: Vellumi: Cruise Journal
list.what: A private cruise journal with photos, voice notes and a day-by-day itinerary that works without ship Wi-Fi.

list.name: Offline AI Voice Translator
list.what: Translates speech out loud without internet once you've downloaded a language model.

list.name: Peak Finder, Mountain ID: MONS
list.what: Names the mountains on the skyline through your camera, from about 1 million peaks, and works offline.

list.name: My City Days
list.what: Makes an AI trip plan for a city from your dates and interests; each plan is bought separately.
